name: Jimmy Carter Boyhood Home
address: Old Plains Highway (Lebanon Cemetery Road), Plains (Archery), Sumter County, GA

location.how: the white farmhouse beside the railroad south of the visitor parking on Google's wide view of the 'Jimmy Carter Boyhood Farm' search (pixel 530, 830 of aerial-wide, 0.245 m/px), converted from the view's centre; 3DEP lidar finds a building under this point (distance 0 m). Approximate to a few metres: the public ortho here is NAIP at 0.6 m and the house sits under trees

standing.note: Identified, not checked for changes: the lidar building at the point covers 297.75 m2 (3,205 SF) with its eaves 2.81 m and peak 6.52 m above the ground ring; the drawing's house with its two porches under the roof and the 2 ft overhang is about 3,240 SF in plan, eave 9.9 ft (3.0 m), ridge 20.8 ft (6.3 m). NPS restored the farm after the 1989 drawings; whether anything outside the drawn walls changed is not known.

sheets.3: north and south elevations (1/4" = 1'-0") with levels
sheets.4: west and east elevations (1/4" = 1'-0") with levels

roof_shape: hip with cross gables (main hip roof; a gabled bay on the west and on the east side)

plan.north: sheet right (E on the sheet); the arrow glyph on sheet 2 is an ambiguous triangle, so this is fixed from the elevations: the screened porch with rubble piers (sheet left) is on the south elevation, the lattice porch with steps (sheet right) on the north elevation, and the west/east elevations show them at the matching ends
plan.note: Start at the main block's sheet-top-left corner (outside face), walk clockwise. The outline is the main block 56'-3 1/2" x 34'-2" with a 16'-0 1/4" wide gabled bay projecting 3'-9 1/2" at sheet top (west) and 2'-0" at sheet bottom (east), both bays between the same 18'-3"+2'-0" and 2'-0"+18'-0 1/4" runs. Main-block walls checked by scaling: 56.28 ft x 33.8-34.1 ft at 100 px/ft.

length.note: top string, middle line: 18'-3" + 2'-0" (the 2'-0" runs from the bay-gable roof line to the bay face). The window string below sums 6'-9 1/2" + 2'-8 1/4" + 10'-9 1/4" = 20'-2 3/4" (1/4" short).

roof.note: main roof hipped (eaves on all four sides); the two bays carry gables (apex 14'-5 1/2") whose ends are rakes, about 16 ft each, so an eaves-all-round gutter run overstates by those two gable ends
roof.derive_note: the main hip roof also covers the screened south porch, so the wall outline offset by the overhang is not the roof

b.note: the porch runs the full south wall; left string segments sum to 34'-2". The room label prints 9'-10" x 39'-5 1/2", which the drawing does not support (the porch scales about 34 ft); likely a mis-lettered 33'-5 1/2" interior

flags.note: Three window strings fall 1/4" short of the run strings they sit under (20'-2 3/4" vs 20'-3" twice, 20'-0" vs 20'-0 1/4"), and the bay-depth segments sum to 3'-9 1/4" against the printed 3'-9 1/2". The chain uses the run strings (18'-3", 2'-0", 16'-0 1/4", 2'-0", 18'-0 1/4" summing to the printed 56'-3 1/2").
Screened south porch excluded as not walled (screens over a low base between rubble piers). If counted as enclosed it adds 9'-10" x 34'-2" = 336 SF.
Porch room label 9'-10" x 39'-5 1/2" conflicts with the drawn and dimensioned porch (34'-2" along the wall).
North arrow glyph on sheet 2 is ambiguous; north = sheet right was fixed from the elevations (see plan.north).
